# Arkaya Labs

> Arkaya Labs is a small research lab. It builds Larch, an open-source AI engine with a
> built-in agent that runs open models on your own Mac or PC (macOS, Windows and Linux;
> Apache 2.0). Arkaya Labs
> benchmarks Larch against llama.cpp, Ollama, MLX and vLLM on consumer hardware and
> publishes every result, including the ones where Larch is slower.

## Pages
- [Larch](https://arkaya-labs.com/projects): what Larch is, the engine and its built-in agent
- [Research](https://arkaya-labs.com/research): research notes and every benchmark result
- [About](https://arkaya-labs.com/about): the lab, its mission and its engineering rules

## Elsewhere
- [larch-engine.com](https://larch-engine.com/): install Larch
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Arkaya-Labs/Larch): source code and benchmark scripts
